already_known: FCFS waiting grows with service-time variability (Pollaczek-Khinchine; Kingman); SRPT is far less sensitive (Schrage 1968; Harchol-Balter 2013). P4 is expected from known theory.
MSJ FCFS has head-of-line blocking and its stability region depends on the job mix (Brill and Green 1984; Grosof, Harchol-Balter, Scheller-Wolf 2022-2023).
State-dependent service slowdowns creating feedback near saturation are known in general terms; not checked for the fragmentation-placement coupling.
Fragmentation hurts and consolidated placement helps (Tiresias NSDI 2019, Philly ATC 2019, Gandiva OSDI 2018).
prior_art.what_is_not_claimed_new: That FCFS is variance-sensitive; that wide-job inflation hurts MSJ FCFS; that fragmentation hurts.
prior_art.candidate_contribution: Within the MSJ model with node locality: a decomposition of fragmentation's extra fcfs delay into state coupling, within-class spread and between-class composition at exactly matched GPU-work. Novelty UNKNOWN.

measurand_validity.model: As E19/E20: N=64, 8-GPU nodes, trace_like (needs 1/2/4/8/16/32, probs .50/.20/.15/.10/.04/.01), exponential sizes mean 1, sigma 0, penalty_mode excess, rate = 1/(1 + pi * excess_nodes), sticky first_fit, no migration, placement never blocks admission.
measurand_validity.arms: F = fragmented run at pi. pi = 0 arms on the same arrivals/needs/sizes with durations multiplied: RP by each job's realised slowdown in F; CS by those slowdowns permuted within need class; CM by the class's GPU-work-weighted mean slowdown; U by the overall GPU-work-weighted mean slowdown. RP, CM, U carry exactly F's GPU-work, CS within about 0.5%.
measurand_validity.srpt: BASE, F, U only; srpt's U uses final rates of re-placed jobs, so its work match is approximate.
measurand_validity.statistics: Q = J_F / J_U per seed. fcfs: a = log(J_F/J_CS) state coupling, b = log(J_CS/J_CM) within-class spread, c = log(J_CM/J_U) composition, T = log(J_F/J_U) = a + b + c. Seed-paired at 320k; shares on seed means.

experiment.grid: trace_like, first_fit, rows (rho, pi) in {(0.55, 0.2), (0.6, 0.2), (0.6, 0.1)} x seeds 2101-2106 x horizons {160k, 320k}; fcfs arms BASE, F, RP, CS, CM, U; srpt arms BASE, F, U. 72 tasks, 648 simulations.

detector.label: DIVERGING if aborted/time limit or alpha >= 0.8; STABLE if alpha <= 0.2; else UNKNOWN. A cell is labelled only when all six seeds agree.
detector.status: alpha is unaudited near a boundary (U-31). The pilot's largest alpha (0.172) is close to 0.2, so (0.6, 0.2) can still come out UNKNOWN; (0.55, 0.2) is in the decision rows for that reason. UNKNOWN cells are not relabelled.

predictions.P0: Instrument (forced): fcfs RP mean JCT equals F within relative 1e-9 in every run. Failure stops the episode as R3.
predictions.P1: The residual replicates against the exact-work control: at (0.6, 0.2), seed-mean Q_fcfs - Q_srpt >= 0.2 and every one of the six seeds > 0. Unscorable if any of fcfs F/U, srpt F/U is not STABLE.
predictions.P2: DECISION. State coupling carries at least half of the fcfs residual: in every decision row ((0.55, 0.2), (0.6, 0.2)) where fcfs F, CS, CM, U are STABLE and mean T > 0, mean a >= 0.5 * mean T. At least one such row.
predictions.P3: Composition hurts fcfs: mean c > 0 in every scorable decision row.
predictions.P4: Within-class spread hurts fcfs (expected from known theory): mean b >= 0 in every scorable decision row. Low resolution expected; report b in SE units.
predictions.P5: The residual grows with pi: at rho 0.6, mean T(pi 0.2) > mean T(pi 0.1).

pre_committed_consequence.P1_fail_or_T_le_0: E19's fcfs residual does not survive an exact-work control on new seeds and stationary windows. Record it as an artefact of the approximate control or of non-stationary windows; close the residual thread; H10 stays a level effect with no fragmentation-specific term.
pre_committed_consequence.P2_pass: Most of fcfs's extra delay under fragmentation comes from the coupling between fragmentation and the cluster state, which no static work-distribution model reproduces. Record as a candidate fragmentation-specific mechanism within this model, with srpt's insensitivity beside it. Next: measure the coupling directly (slowdown vs occupancy at placement).
pre_committed_consequence.P2_fail_c_largest: The residual is mostly composition (wide jobs inflated, MSJ FCFS sensitive to that): a change of job-size distribution, i.e. known theory; no fragmentation-specific dynamic.
pre_committed_consequence.P2_fail_other: Report the three shares as measured and do not name a mechanism.
pre_committed_consequence.P2_unscorable: Say the decomposition was not answered on these windows either; do not interpret Q; close C-056 and move to C-057 or another question.
